summary.zh: 波兰种＋牛奶汤种 · 2 个 450 g 吐司模 · 30 分钟
summary.en: Poolish + milk tangzhong · two 450 g loaf pans · 30 minutes

title.en: Milk tangzhong (may use a scald instead)

detail.zh: 操作中后加；起始量待核
detail.en: Added during mixing; initial amount unconfirmed

detail.zh: 原记录未注明勺的大小

steps.zh: 用波兰种和牛奶汤种做主面团，总面粉 540 g。揉面用压叠手法，操作中追加 50 g 牛奶。
steps.en: Make the main dough with the poolish and milk tangzhong (540 g total flour). Knead using a press-and-fold technique; add another 50 g of milk during mixing.

steps.zh: 把馅料拌匀。整形中间松弛两次，各 30 分钟。加入芝麻馅并做成山形吐司。
steps.en: Mix the filling. Rest the dough twice for 30 minutes each during shaping. Add the sesame filling and shape into mountain-top loaves.

steps.zh: 原记录是「310 度烤 30 分钟」。出炉效果满意，第二天早上仍然柔软。
steps.en: The original note says ‘bake at 310 degrees for 30 minutes.’ The result was good and still soft the next morning.

notes.zh: 温度单位待核，按美式烤箱推测为 °F。主面团牛奶总量、每条放入的馅量及发酵时间待补。
notes.en: Temperature unit unconfirmed; °F is inferred from the American oven. Total milk in the main dough, filling per loaf, and proofing times still need confirmation.
